title: Discover extension operation stdout
description: Represents a DSC manifest path or manifest content, with optional registry provenance.
markdownDescription:
***
[_Online Documentation_][00]
***

Represents a DSC manifest path or manifest content. DSC expects every JSON Line emitted to stdout
for the **Discover** operation to adhere to this schema. An extension indicates that it supports
the **Discover** operation by defining the [discover][01] field in its manifest.

The output must be a JSON object that defines exactly one of `manifestPath` or `manifestContent`.
Remotely discovered resources can include their registry friendly name in `registry`.

If the extension doesn't discover any resources, it shouldn't emit any data to stdout.

Unless the extension raises an error, it should exit with code `0`, even when no resources are
discovered.

[00]: https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/dsc/reference/schemas/extension/stdout/discover?view=dsc-3.0&preserve-view=true
[01]: https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/dsc/reference/schemas/extension/manifest/discover?view=dsc-3.0&preserve-view=true

manifestPath.title: DSC manifest path
manifestPath.description: Defines the absolute path to a DSC resource manifest on the system.
manifestPath.markdownDescription:
***
[_Online Documentation_][00]
***

Defines the absolute path to a DSC resource manifest on the system. DSC expects this value to
be the absolute path to a manifest file that exists. If this value is a relative path, or if
the manifest doesn't exist, DSC raises an error.

[00]: https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/dsc/reference/schemas/extension/stdout/discover?view=dsc-3.0&preserve-view=true#manifestPath

registry.description: The registry friendly name for a remotely discovered resource.
